description: 3 exemplars + 2 near-misses + 1 counterexample. Authored 2026-10-06 while landing `road-to-a-spend-bound-only-where-one-was-set`, which touched SKILL.md and two reference files under this skill and tripped `check_routing_coverage`'s forward-only corpus requirement. Exemplars cover the explicit council-poll ask and the 'cross-check with another model' phrasing the description itself names. Near-misses are the two siblings the skill's own See-also section names as the nearest neighbours: `subagent-orchestration` (parallel fan-out, no external model diversity) and `/team` (one strong model with repo depth, not a breadth poll). The counterexample is an unrelated roadmap-authoring ask that shares no vocabulary with polling an outside model.

queries.q: poll OpenAI and Anthropic for a neutral second opinion on this roadmap before we commit to it
cross-check this diff with another model before I merge it
hol dir eine zweite, neutrale Meinung von einem anderen KI-Modell zu diesem Prompt
spin up a few subagents to search the codebase for every caller of this function in parallel
queries.note: in-process multi-agent fan-out with no outside model and no network spend → subagent-orchestration, not the council

queries.q: bring in a strong model to work through this repo with me and implement the fix collaboratively
queries.note: one model with repo access going deep on an implementation, not a breadth poll of several outside models on an artefact → /team

queries.q: write a roadmap for migrating the billing module to the new provider
queries.note: unrelated authoring task; shares no vocabulary with polling an outside model for a second opinion
